Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Bharti Rally 2025 – Full Details

Indian Air Force (IAF) has announced a recruitment rally for male candidates, including Indian and Gorkha, to join as Airmen in Group ‘Y’ (Non-Technical) for the Medical Assistant Trade. Rally for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment 2025 has started from 29 January 2025 & the rally end date 06 February 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Rally Start Date : 29 January 2025
  • Rally Last Date : 06 February 2025

Application Fee

  • No Fees For All Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
